title: Karva
desc: An NRI seeks the help of a television crew to sell his haunted ancestral property. However, the daughter of a wealthy man gets kidnapped and is held hostage in the same bungalow.

title: Raghavendra Stores
desc: Hayavadana and his wife go to a resort on a holiday. However, when they encounter politicians over there, chaos ensues, as they strive to save their friend, who gets in trouble with the ministers.

title: Aakash
desc: While working odd jobs, Aakash, a practical man, meets Nandini, a rich girl, who falls for him, but he does not reciprocate. However, her brothers misunderstand their bond and make his life hell.

title: Bharjari
desc: Surya, an orphan raised by the best friend of his deceased mother, wants to become a soldier. He falls in love with a woman but soon gets an offer to join the army.
